resumen: Seated, the bar comes down from overhead to the chest. Same vertical pull as the pull-up, with the load you choose: the way into the group for anyone not doing pull-ups yet.
ejecucion: Sit with your thighs held down and grip the bar overhand, a little wider than your shoulders.
Straighten your arms fully overhead and lean your torso back slightly, without swinging.
Before you pull, drop your shoulders: move them away from your ears.
Pull by driving your elbows down and back until the bar reaches your upper chest.
Let it back up under control until your arms are straight, without letting your shoulders ride up at the end.
matices: Which grip works the lats hardest is not settled. What studies do repeat is that forearm orientation matters more than width: an overhand grip shows more activation than an underhand one, and differences between widths are small. The comparison with the pull-up is not firm either: with the load matched, the values are similar.
